keyVerseDR: "Be ye kind one to another; merciful, forgiving one another, even as God hath forgiven you in Christ." (Eph 4:32)

level1.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Forgiveness
level1.story: Forgiveness means letting go of hurt and giving people a second chance, just as God forgives us.
level1.keyLine: God forgives me, so I forgive.
level1.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice forgiveness all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: How did we forgive each other this week?
Why does God want us to forgive?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level1.prayer: Merciful Jesus, help me forgive others as You forgive me. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Say 'I forgive you' when someone is sorry
TUE: Don't hit back when someone is unkind
WED: Say sorry when you hurt someone
THU: Give a sibling a second chance
FRI: Pray the Our Father slowly
SAT: Pray for someone who was unkind to you

level2.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Forgiveness
level2.story: Forgiveness and mercy mean forgiving those who hurt us, giving them a second chance, and not taking revenge. Forgiving does not mean the hurt didn't matter; it means we choose to let go of anger and wish the other person good. God forgives us every time we are sorry, and Jesus forgave even from the cross. We pray, "Forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us."
level2.keyLine: God forgives me, so I forgive.
level2.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice forgiveness all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: How did we forgive each other this week?
How did God help us grow in forgiveness?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level2.prayer: Merciful Jesus, help me forgive others as You forgive me. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Let go of an old grudge
TUE: Forgive without bringing it up again
WED: Ask forgiveness from someone you hurt
THU: Choose not to get even
FRI: Make an examination of conscience
SAT: Plan to go to Confession soon
